title: Raw Steak
summary: Provides 10 Camp Supplies toward a Long Rest.

fields.Camp Supplies: 10 points. A full Long Rest normally needs 40 supplies, or 80 on Tactician and Honour.
fields.Acquisition: Available as loot or from traders.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
